title: Traffic Sculptor: Console flow for geo-tiering and model-fallback composition
creator: Avery Chen
description: Customers need a guided, low-friction way in Console to build routing policies that combine region selection, tier routing, and fallback model variants while understanding the cost/latency trade-offs and safety constraints. Traffic Sculptor is a step-by-step Console flow and preview experience that lets users: author composite policies (region -> tier -> model variant), run a simulated traffic replay to preview routing outcomes, surface cost/latency estimates per-route, and get actionable lint/fix suggestions for unsafe or incompatible fallbacks. The flow targets platform users who are onboarding Dedicated or Private deployments as well as hosted customers who need granular control over geography and model fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Console has a new guided "Traffic Sculptor" authoring flow reachable from Routing > New Policy that supports composing region rules, tier selection, and fallback model variants.
Users can add multiple region blocks with priority ordering, attach tier weights (e.g., primary, secondary, burst), and define model-variant fallbacks per tier.

Simulator runs a synthetic replay of representative traffic (user-provided sample or default dataset) and shows a heatmap of routed percent, expected P95 latency, and estimated per-token cost for each route.

Policy linter runs on save and surfaces errors/warnings for compatibility (e.g., private-only model pinned to hosted fallback), missing rollout guardrails, and risky fallback chains with suggested fixes.
Preview UI shows a before/after diff for existing policies when editing (traffic delta and cost delta) and supports a canary rollout knob that generates a simulated impact projection.
Backend persists policy as same canonical DSL used by routing engine and can be validated by runtime (request schema + model capabilities).
scope_out_of_scope: Automated rollout (actual traffic shaping) — only preview/simulate in this ticket.
Long-term telemetry ingestion pipeline — will use existing replay/export APIs.
Advanced ML-driven recommendations for optimal tier weights — future follow-up.
engineering_notes: Simulator will reuse /internal/traffic/replay service; need small adapter to accept policy DSL and return per-route simulated metrics.
Routing DSL: mapping must include region selectors (region code or geo-radius), tier ids, fallback variant arrays, and explicit compatibility tags (e.g., privateOnly:true).
Backend validation should call model-catalog service for model capabilities and cost profile; cache recent profiles to avoid long sim latencies.
Consider incremental linting on field blur to surface early feedback; heavy lint rules run on save.
UI should render estimated cost using same unit rates as billing service; stubbed rates acceptable for initial MVP but must be tagged as 'estimate'.
Security: policy authoring must respect RBAC; console checks current user's permissions before allowing private model selection.
